prompt: Create the complete user manual for this product: about twelve chapters for administrators, end users and support staff, with shared terminology and screenshots, to be written over several sessions. Perform only the first safe assessment: select the workflow, load the applicable skills, and record decision.md; do not write the plan or chapters.

files.README.md:
# Keyforge

Keyforge manages API keys, teams and audit logs. It has an admin console, an end-user portal and a support view.
